  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Pool_Org" name="Organization" processRef="Process_VacationRequest" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacations Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supervisor" name="Immediate Supervisor">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Receive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Decide</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Return</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_HR" name="Human Resources Representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Procedures</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Handled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_1" name="Vacation requirement arises" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Register" name="Register the requirement" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Receive" name="Receive the request" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Decide" name="Approve or reject the request" />

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Review" name="Review the rejection reasons" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Application rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Notify" name="Generate notification to the Human Resources Representative" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procedures" name="Complete the respective management procedures" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Handled" name="Vacation request handled" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_1" targetRef="Task_Submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="Task_Register" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Approved" targetRef="Task_Notify" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Approved" targetRef="Task_Return" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_Return" targetRef="Task_Review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_Review" targetRef="End_Rejected" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_Procedures" targetRef="End_Handled" />
